messages:
maya: Quick question — noticed weirdness when my chart uses map lookup with default vs empty string for secret refs. env var ends up empty instead of not rendered. Repro:

maya: values.yaml
```yaml
service:
  creds:
    name: ""
``` 

maya: template snippet:
```tpl
envFrom:
  - secretRef:
      name: {{ default .Values.service.creds.name .Values.service.creds.name }}
```

maya: If creds.name is empty string I get an empty `name:` field in the rendered k8s manifest (invalid). If key is omitted entirely it works. Is there a Helm template pattern to avoid emitting `name: ""` when value is empty vs not defined?

adrian: Use `if` to guard: `{{- if .Values.service.creds.name }}name: {{ .Values.service.creds.name }}{{- end }}`. Helm will not render the block if empty. :+1:

lucas: You can also use `default` with `empty` check: `{{- $n := default "" .Values.service.creds.name }}{{- if ne $n "" }}name: {{$n}}{{- end }}` — same idea.

sarah-eng: FWIW we prefer the `if` for readability. Also watch out for `toYaml`/indentation when doing whole maps.

maya: Awesome, thanks. One follow-up — what if we want to conditionally include the whole `envFrom` list only when any creds fields exist? Example: when both `name` and `optional` maybe.

adrian: Wrap the whole `envFrom` section in `if` that checks at least one: `{{- if or .Values.service.creds.name .Values.service.creds.optional }}` then the `envFrom:` block.

maya: Example I ended up with:
```tpl
{{- if .Values.service.creds.name }}
envFrom:
  - secretRef:
      name: {{ .Values.service.creds.name }}
{{- end }}
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staged templating test passed on staging cluster (kubeval ok) :white_check_mark:

lucas: Also note that Helm treats zero-length string as defined (not nil), so `if .Values.foo` will be false for "". Good to verify in unit tests.

maya: Thanks all — will update chart and open PR with tests + kubeval check.
